label: Bible Study
prompt: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his _____.
verse: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
note: Said the night before he went and did exactly that.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never _____ thee, nor forsake thee.
verse: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
note: In the Greek it's a pile of negatives — never, no, not leave thee — divine emphasis.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a _____ giver.
verse: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
note: 'Not grudgingly, or of necessity' — God audits the attitude, not just the amount.

label: Deep Water
prompt: They that observe lying _____ forsake their own mercy.
verse: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
note: Prayed from inside the fish: clinging to worthless idols means dropping the mercy already in your hands.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no _____.
verse: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
note: No shedding of blood, no 'remission' — the sending away of sin, the canceling of the debt.
